span.div:
1. Raft requires strict majority (3 of 5)
for any commit
2. 2-2-1 split means neither side has
majority → no commits
3. Only odd-numbered clusters prevent tie
splits
4. Leader leases (epoch-based) prevent stale
leader serving requests
